# EnterpriseGlue v0.15.3 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.15.2`.

## Highlights

- **plugin-installation-toolchain:** Compiles the public Plugin Manager tool binaries explicitly for each target architecture and adds an amd64/arm64 build gate before release.

## User and administrator impact

- Connected and air-gapped plugin installation images can be published for both amd64 and arm64 without relying on native-only Go installation behavior.
- Pull requests now exercise the same cross-compilation path used by protected multi-architecture publication through an isolated BuildKit container builder.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Use plugin installer 0.2.2, Plugin Manager 0.1.2, and the matching 0.2.2 and 0.1.2 Helm charts; the failed v0.15.2 toolchain run did not produce a qualified release receipt.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The target-architecture binaries retain the patched Go, gRPC, x/mod, and x/text dependency floors introduced in v0.15.2.
- Both amd64 and arm64 tool stages must build successfully in an isolated Docker container builder before the native runtime images are scanned and a protected publication may start.

## Documentation

- The generated release guide records the replacement toolchain versions and the unqualified v0.15.2 publication attempt.

## Known limitations

- The failed v0.15.2 toolchain workflow stopped before publishing images, charts, signatures, attestations, or an offline receipt.

## Rollback

- Keep the currently qualified plugin toolchain installed until the 0.2.2/0.1.2 replacement receipt has been verified.

- PR-gated amd64 and arm64 ORAS/Cosign cross-compilation
